title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not part of the 1976 divided-power De Rham notes. It is a typescript page (p. 117, Exposé IX) of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie', filed in the folder. The neighbouring pages are handwritten notes on divided-power De Rham complexes, so the topic changes abruptly.

Setting: S is the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring with generic point η and residue characteristic p. One wants to extend an 'extension panachée' of Barsotti–Tate (p-divisible) groups from η to S. Roughly, this is a three-step filtered BT group X with sub F, middle P and quotients E and Q, glued compatibly.

End of the proof of 9.5.6:
1. For each n, the map X(n) → Q(n) on n-torsion levels is surjective on generic fibres, hence surjective.
2. Q(n) is étale over S, so X(n) → Q(n) is flat, hence a (faithfully flat) epimorphism. So X → Q is an epimorphism level by level.
3. The kernel F̄ is therefore a BT group, and X is an extension of Q by F̄.
4. Tate's full-faithfulness theorem for p-divisible groups over a DVR with generic characteristic 0 extends the generic isomorphism F_η ≅ F̄_η to F ≅ F̄.
5. The same argument applied to Ē = X/P gives E ≅ Ē.
6. Hence X is an extension panachée of E by F extending X_η.

Remarks 9.5.6.4:
(a) The last assertion of 9.5.6 should hold without restriction on K, since Tate's theorem itself should.
(b) An alternative proof of the good-reduction criterion 5.10 (Néron–Ogg–Shafarevich type). Reduce to semi-stable reduction, view T_ℓ(A_K) as an extension panachée (9.6), apply 9.5.6 to get vanishing of the monodromy pairing u_ℓ, then use 11.6.2 a) to get T_ℓ(A_K)^t = 0.

9.5.8 begins: for ℓ ≠ p, the BT groups over S and over K are just Galois representations of Gal(k̄/k), respectively Gal(K̄/K), on free Z_ℓ-modules.
errors: No mathematical errors. The flatness step is terse: X(n) → Q(n) is flat by the fibrewise flatness criterion, since X(n) is flat over S and Q(n) is étale over S. This is standard and correct.
Archival note: this page belongs to the SGA 7 Exposé IX typescript, not to cote 136's subject (the divided-power De Rham complex). The previous- and next-page context is unrelated.

ideas.what: Extending extensions panachées of Barsotti–Tate groups from the generic fibre over a DVR, using Tate's full faithfulness
ideas.modern_name: Extension of filtered p-divisible groups / Tate's theorem on p-divisible groups
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (SGA 7 Exp. IX); Tate (1967) for full faithfulness

deep.surprise_reason: This is a page of the published SGA 7 Exposé IX typescript, misfiled among the 1976 notes. Its content is in print, and the open expectation in Remark (a) was later settled by de Jong.
transcription_corrections: The page number '435' at the bottom and '129' in the margin are archival foliation, not part of the text.
The page header 'IX' denotes SGA 7 Exposé IX. The transcription is otherwise accurate against the image.
